name: s7-ghaele-lifecycle
description: Sprint 7 recovery C2 (parent R5-F1): the short affected Ghaele lifecycle check only, on whichever product package the session loads (the existing candidate-3 package), with the corrected external harness. Step lifecycle: the cast ownership boundaries, the pending verdict and its post-disposal late-result negative control, and the real-spawn detection witness; every correlated late unit is reconciled with the probe's destruction owner on release and its settlement observed, so a still-present, unreadable or unknown-ownership unit fails ProbeSlot isolation. No timeline, expiry, combat or visibility step (accepted at their own identities).
